title: ResinBlock-for-tempBlock
description: A pack for using resin blocks as temporary blocks
body:
# ResinBlock-for-tempBlock
Adds a vanilla-style outline, similar to that of an iron block, to the texture of the resin block.

Useful when using the resin block as a temporary block.
![resin block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3d78681d99642a6a557f943cfcb4fcd11f837f2_0.webp)
